speech-analyzer 1.0.0 Changelog

- Initial release.
- Provides 20-dimension quantitative analysis of oral expression quality for livestreams, podcasts, and speeches.
- Outputs structured Markdown analysis reports based on audio files.
- Covers standard (15) and advanced (5) analysis dimensions, including speech habits, acoustic features, topic structure, speaker interaction, cognitive load, and impromptu speaking evaluation.
- Delivers actionable, data-driven suggestions and supports comparison across multiple sessions.
